text:
When setting project goals, it is important to be as clear and structured as possible. One effective method is to use SMART goals, which should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This ensures you and your team know exactly what to work towards.

You should also break big goals down into smaller milestones. These help you track progress and stay motivated. Additionally, define clear deliverables—the specific products or results you need to complete at each stage.

Finally, make sure all stakeholders are aligned with the goals. This means everyone involved agrees on what success looks like and understands their role. With SMART goals, milestones, deliverables, and stakeholder alignment, your project has a strong foundation for success.
